verdict.rationale: GrowthBook explicitly documents an OpenFeature provider, stating switching providers only requires changing the bootstrap, not flag call code — directly addressing vendor lock-in concerns via OpenFeature. This is corroborated by the broader SDK ecosystem (24 SDKs) and local evaluation model. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation specifically of the OpenFeature provider, and detail on which SDK languages support the OpenFeature integration.
